name: sara
description: Sara — personal AI agent and virtual character (modular monorepo).

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @sara/api" "npm run dev -w @sara/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @sara/api && npm run build -w @sara/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @sara/types && npm run build -w @sara/config && npm run build -w @sara/logger && npm run build -w @sara/db && npm run build -w @sara/clipfinder && npm run build -w @sara/ui
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w @sara/api" "npm run start -w @sara/web"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
